card.name: Water volumes when mixing doses
card.fires_on: Spaces, opening parentheses and nearby words just before a metric volume (like 60 mL) that follows a household amount such as a cup or tablespoon. Seen in dilution or mixing directions.

modes.label: Before metric volume
modes.description: The space or opening parenthesis after 'approximately' or 'about' that comes right before an mL amount.
